publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.20 updates local onboarding and operator workflows. For local sign-in, open the private RER_OPEN link. RER_READY opens the public Lobby. New local installations can use localhost with an explicit port for runner control and enroll a passkey. CLI archive export and import report the archive path on success, and the guides explain how to verify a native CLI session before stopping dev. New definition import approvals use the signed-in owner, and a resumed apply keeps its original approval after an email change. Monitoring read keys honor selected tags, and the console offers Copy key during one-time display. The updated guides cover scoped read keys, second factors, and running hosted health and private runner commands with the installed rer runtime. This upgrade uses the exact @runeditrun/rer 0.2.125 pin. There are 91 SQL migration files before and after. All 91 migration files from 0.5.19 are byte-identical. No migration files or required settings were added. Monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are retained on upgrade. Back up first through Settings > Backup and files > Download backup with a second factor verified within five minutes. Keep private settings and .rer/deploy separately, plus a hosted database backup if applicable. For local CLI backup, stop dev and run rer export --output exports/uptime.rer with the verified UPTIME_ACCESS_COOKIE described in the backup guide. Keep it private. Update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, stop dev or preview and deploy as usual. Keep the deployment receipt and use the existing installation keys for this upgrade. The mail enable/disable commands and legacy SendGrid selector guidance under 0.5.16 still apply. Earlier upgrade cautions still apply, including older heartbeat output, UptimeRobot monitor CSV import, restoration of the erased-people list, empty company decision feeds, the 64 KiB response-body limit, and large-scale archive operation that has yet to be established. Pingdom TMS scripts and recordings, Page Speed, relationships and history remain unconverted. Live account cutover and managed geographic equivalence have yet to be established. Imported definitions stay paused and credentials need local re-entry. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png, captured on 0.4.0. — Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-21.
